title: BlockForm+
description: BlockForm+ — Add Item Forms for Unobtainable Blocks
body:
BlockForm+ is a lightweight Minecraft mod that adds item forms for blocks that normally cannot be held or obtained in vanilla Minecraft. This includes special technical blocks and structures such as: 

- End Portal
- Nether Portal
- Air
- Cave Air
- Void Air
- And other normally unobtainable or non-item blocks

With this mod, creators, map makers, and modpack developers can experiment more freely, place technical blocks directly, or use them in custom systems.
All added items are safely registered, balanced for creative use, and fully compatible with other mods.

Perfect for creative building, map creation, datapack development, and experimentation.
